_note: Directory only — links to the official government portal for each scheme. Eligibility rules change and depend on personal/state details this site does not have, so we never claim to check eligibility ourselves; always confirm on the official site.

schemes.name: PM-KISAN
schemes.summary: ₹6,000/year income support for small and marginal farmer families, paid directly to their bank account.

schemes.name: Ayushman Bharat (PM-JAY)
schemes.summary: Free hospital treatment up to ₹5 lakh/family/year for economically vulnerable households.

schemes.name: PM Awas Yojana
schemes.summary: Subsidised home loans and direct assistance to build a pucca house, rural and urban.

schemes.name: PM Ujjwala Yojana
schemes.summary: Free LPG gas connection for women from below-poverty-line households.

schemes.name: PM Jan Dhan Yojana
schemes.summary: Zero-balance bank accounts with a RuPay debit card and accident insurance cover.

schemes.name: Atal Pension Yojana
schemes.summary: A guaranteed monthly pension of ₹1,000-5,000 after age 60, for workers in the unorganised sector.

schemes.name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
schemes.summary: A high-interest savings scheme for a girl child's education and marriage, opened by a parent/guardian.

schemes.name: PM SVANidhi
schemes.summary: Small working-capital loans for street vendors, with a subsidy for repaying on time.

schemes.name: National Scholarship Portal
schemes.summary: A single portal for hundreds of central and state student scholarships, pre/post-matric and merit-based.

schemes.name: PM Fasal Bima Yojana
schemes.summary: Low-premium crop insurance against natural calamities, pests and disease.

schemes.name: Mudra Yojana
schemes.summary: Collateral-free loans up to ₹20 lakh for small businesses and micro-entrepreneurs.

schemes.name: e-Shram
schemes.summary: A national database and card for unorganised-sector workers, unlocking social security benefits.
